plugin.name: Compatibility note
plugin.description: Not compatible with other mods that replace the HUD (hudmenu.gfx). Disable them before using Horizon's HUD. The optional Quick Menu (Favorites) module replaces Interface\favoritesmenu.swf and favoritesmenu_lrg.swf. If you use another favorites or quick-menu mod, untick Quick Menu (Favorites) on the Optional Modules page. A Vortex update that reuses earlier choices may untick it; re-tick it to keep Horizon's quick menu.

plugin.name: Horizon font (Exo 2 + Roboto)
plugin.description: Installs the Horizon fonts (Exo 2 and Roboto, SIL OFL 1.1): Interface\fonts_horizon.swf and Interface\fontconfig_en.txt. This replaces any other font mod's fontconfig_en.txt. Enables the font options in the F11 settings window.

plugin.name: Keep my current font
plugin.description: Installs no font files and leaves your current fontconfig (vanilla or another font mod) alone. Horizon UI falls back to the game font, and the font options in the F11 settings window will be grayed out.

plugin.name: Default settings
plugin.description: Horizon UI's standard settings. Moragar's Choice won't be in F11's Presets list.

plugin.name: Moragar's Choice
plugin.description: Starts you on the author's own settings, matching the Nexus screenshots. Only applies if you don't already have saved Horizon settings; your existing settings are never overwritten. Also adds Moragar's Choice to F11's Presets list so you can apply it any time. If you skip it, it won't be in the list; reinstall and pick it to add it later.

plugin.name: Quick Menu (Favorites)
plugin.description: Horizon-styled quick menu, the favorites cross (Interface\favoritesmenu.swf + _lrg). Replaces the game's quick menu and any other mod that replaces those files. Ticked by default; untick this to keep the game's quick menu or another mod's. A Vortex update or reinstall that reuses your earlier choices may untick this; re-tick it to keep Horizon's quick menu. Unticked, F11 > CARDS > QUICK MENU > HORIZON STYLE appears locked. When the module is installed, that same setting can also turn the Horizon look off.

plugin.name: Comms (Subtitles and Dialogue)
plugin.description: Horizon-styled subtitles and speaker card (Interface\hudmessagesmenu.gfx + _lrg). The next page lets you choose whether to also install the Horizon dialogue menu, which replaces other dialogue menu mods. Conflicts with other subtitles mods and any other mod that replaces hudmessagesmenu: install one or the other. Not ticked by default if one of them is detected. Modules you don't install appear locked in the F11 settings window.

plugin.name: Scanner
plugin.description: Horizon-styled hand scanner (Interface\monoclemenu.swf + _lrg). Replaces the game's scanner and the scanner of other scanner mods: let Horizon overwrite them (load Horizon after them). Hides the Horizon HUD while scanning (F11 > SCANNER). Scanner popup options need Comms.

plugin.name: Scope (hold-breath chip)
plugin.description: Horizon-styled hold-breath prompt for weapon scopes (Interface\scopemenu.swf + _lrg): a chip with a target icon, the label and an O2 meter that turns yellow / red at the HUD's low-O2 levels; move and size it in ARRANGE CARDS. The game's own prompt is hidden, never removed, and the scope works as before. It replaces the game's scope menu, so it is ticked by default: if you use another scope mod, untick Scope. Turn the chip off with ScopeHoldBreathChip=0 under [Scope] in HorizonUI.user.ini.

plugin.name: Message Log (Notifications)
plugin.description: Adds the Message Log to the F11 menu.

plugin.name: Horizon dialogue (replaces other dialogue mods)
plugin.description: Installs the Horizon dialogue menu (Interface\dialoguemenu.swf + _lrg and the comms_dialogue marker). It replaces any other dialogue menu mod. If the installer detected one (this option is then not pre-selected): another dialogue mod was found. Horizon dialogue replaces it; pick this to replace, or Skip to keep it. Ship hail menus are not changed.

plugin.name: Skip Horizon dialogue (use if another dialogue mod is installed)
plugin.description: Installs only the Horizon subtitles half of Comms and no dialogue files. Keeps your other dialogue mod or the vanilla dialogue menu. The dialogue section of the F11 COMMS tab stays locked. Recommended when another dialogue mod is found.
